warmups: max(5, 2 * concurrency), excluded from timing; same policy for baseline and candidate

metrics.throughput_frames_s: total_audio_frames / duration; PCM sample frames, not codec tokens
metrics.ttfa_p50_ms: median_audio_ttfp_ms; request start to first audio
metrics.rtf_mean: mean_audio_rtf; arithmetic mean(request start to last audio / audio duration)

quality.protocol: vLLM-Omni Seed-TTS WER; separate from performance
quality.gate: candidate aggregate WER <= baseline on identical rows and scorer; all outputs nonempty and finite; no request failures
quality.scorer: Whisper-large-v3 via native Seed-TTS; SIM excluded for default voice without reference speaker; UTMOS supplementary
quality.identity_gate: identical ordered utterance IDs and original reference text; identical frozen scorer manifests

workload.selection: first 256 rows, original order, no oversampling
workload.user_prompt_wrapper: benchmark_readback.py; target remains unwrapped for WER

supersedes: protocol-v4.json (never used for formal trials): resolve independent review findings on conditioning coverage and deterministic JIT retry rules before any formal paired trial

runtime.isolation: task-local PYTHONPATH overlay, shared environment unchanged

raw_audio_gate: all ordered audio_request_metrics rows successful with finite positive audio measurements; recompute aggregates and check 24 kHz sample-rate consistency
scope: text readback full pipeline; speech-input accuracy remains separate and unverified
conditioning: For every server process/configuration instance, run all seven concurrency points in ascending order, 256 rows each, using benchmark-v4.sh. Every conditioning JSON must pass check_results_v3.py with expected=256 before measurements. Record server PID/start identity privately and a public run identity. Any restart/config change requires a fresh conditioning matrix.
comparison: All formal baseline/candidate measurements must use this revision; v3 results remain historical baseline/screening, not pooled with v4.
harness: benchmark-v4.sh plus unchanged benchmark_readback.py; native CLI and metrics unchanged

jit_observation.evidence: Record server log byte offset immediately before and after each measured matrix. Inspect the retained interval for every verbose monitor line containing during inference:. This conservatively includes native warmups and CLI setup time in that matrix, not only timed requests. Save byte bounds, raw interval SHA256, redacted JIT lines and count. Verify startup confirms verbose JIT monitoring is active.
jit_observation.limitation: vLLM monitor covers its supported JIT hooks; absence of logged events is not proof that no unmonitored compilation occurred.

paired_attempts.retry_unit: entire paired repetition, both arms, preserving assigned order
paired_attempts.selection: Use the first pair with complete conditioning/raw measurement gates and zero observed JIT events in both measured matrices. Retain every attempt and reason. Do not remove requests or select fastest runs. If neither attempt qualifies, report INCONCLUSIVE; do not claim promotion.
paired_attempts.target_reporting: Report every qualifying replicate and pooled equal-request metrics; each candidate replicate must independently satisfy both endpoint RTF targets for a target-attainment claim.
